findings.fix: Rename tools/logging.py to a non-stdlib-shadowing name (event_logger.py) and delete _force_stdlib_logging_module from both test files (the sys.path guard can then also go).

findings.title: After a reconnect, _show_missed_errors prints ring-buffer errors that the main loop immediately fetches and prints again (same since-cursor), duplicating error output; missed errors are also fetched twice over the network
findings.impact: Duplicate error banners after every reconnect; combined with the last_ts defect, duplicated entries in the audit log.
findings.fix: Either drop _show_missed_errors (the normal loop already replays events since last_ts) or advance last_ts using the events it fetched and skip re-printing them in the main pass.

findings.title: PostgreSQL schema gets almost no indexes: migrations' indexes are never applied on PG, and _ensure_core_tables creates only idx_obe_sync_key
findings.impact: On Postgres, order-book sync and analysis queries degrade linearly with table growth; after weeks of live trading the broker-sync loop slows, widening the window in which the DB view lags the broker.
findings.fix: Mirror the SQLite/migration indexes in _ensure_core_tables/_ensure_order_book_table/_ensure_account_status_table for Postgres.

findings.title: TOCTOU in _ensure_order_book_table column upgrade and unguarded multi-statement sequences on a single shared connection
findings.impact: Rare startup crash on legacy-table upgrade under concurrent first writes; kb_fts index can silently lose a document (search stops finding it). Low probability but silent.
findings.fix: Guard _ensure_* with an asyncio.Lock (or run once at initialize), and wrap multi-statement sequences in explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT.

findings.title: is_compressed=0 keeps a legacy plain-JSON read path for agent_conversations.messages (dual-format column: TEXT JSON or zlib BLOB)
findings.impact: Dual-format storage in one TEXT-affinity column; every future consumer must implement both decoders or corrupt/miss data. Owner wants compat duals removed.
findings.fix: One-time backfill compressing (or decompressing) all legacy rows, then drop the is_compressed flag and the branch.

findings.title: agent_decisions.confidence column is never written
findings.impact: Dead schema; misleads anyone querying agent_decisions.confidence directly (always NULL, looks like agents never report confidence).
findings.fix: Either write decision confidence into the column in save_agent_decision or drop the column from the migration going forward.

findings.title: kb_documents/kb_fts DDL is maintained in two places: migration 007 and _ensure_kb_table
findings.impact: Schema drift risk: editing one copy leaves fresh installs and existing installs with different kb schemas depending on which DDL ran first.
findings.fix: Keep only the migration; delete the DDL from _ensure_kb_table (or delete migration 007 and keep the lazy ensure — one owner only).

findings.title: get_analysis_records filters on COALESCE(decision_type_new, decision_type) — unindexable full scan of ever-growing agent_decisions
findings.impact: Analysis-record queries slow linearly over weeks of trading; on the shared single SQLite connection this stalls concurrent order-book writes behind it.
findings.fix: After removing the decision_type_new shim, filter on `decision_type = ?` and add an index on (decision_type, decided_at DESC); interim: create an expression index.

findings.title: sqlite.py uses typing.Any in annotations without importing it (masked only by `from __future__ import annotations`)
findings.impact: Latent NameError; breaks any tooling that resolves these annotations at runtime.
findings.fix: Add `from typing import Any` to sqlite.py.

findings.title: Vertical (price) coordinates are scaled by horizontalPixelRatio instead of verticalPixelRatio
findings.impact: At fractional devicePixelRatio (e.g. Windows 125%/150% scaling, browser zoom) every drawing primitive's Y position is off by (hRatio/vRatio) relative to the candles — a saved horizontal line, fib level, or trendline renders at a visibly wrong price. Trader draws at 1.08500, line displays several pixels away from that price. Exactly the 'subtly wrong, misleads decisions' class.
findings.fix: Use scope.verticalPixelRatio for priceToY and scope.horizontalPixelRatio for timeToX: `const hRatio = scope.horizontalPixelRatio; const vRatio = scope.verticalPixelRatio; priceToY: ... y * vRatio; timeToX: ... x * hRatio`.

findings.title: requiredPoints map in the click handler duplicates REQUIRED_POINTS exported from drawing/types.ts
findings.impact: Two sources of truth for how many clicks finalize each tool. Adding a tool or changing a point count in one table but not the other makes drawings finalize with the wrong number of points (silently truncated by `points.slice(0, needed)`).
findings.fix: Delete the inline literal and use the imported constant: `const needed = REQUIRED_POINTS[pendingToolRef.current]`.

findings.title: Future-whitespace bar interval derived from the gap between the first two candles (and hardcoded 300s for single-candle data) — a weekend/holiday gap at the window start mis-spaces all 200 future slots
findings.impact: Future whitespace times are wildly wrong (e.g. 200 bars * 49h ≈ 14 months), so future-anchored drawings, markers, and futureBars padding land at wrong x-positions or become unreachable; drawing clicks in the future area record wrong timestamps that persist in saved drawings.
findings.fix: Derive the interval robustly, e.g. the median (or minimum) of successive time deltas over the whole array, or pass the timeframe seconds explicitly as a prop.

findings.title: All fixed pixel sizes (handle radius, fonts, arrow size, tick length, label padding, lineWidth) are used in bitmap coordinate space without pixel-ratio scaling — rendered at half size on 2x HiDPI displays
findings.impact: On any HiDPI/retina display (pixel ratio 2) every drawing's text, handles, arrows and line widths render at half the intended CSS size — labels near-unreadable, 1px lines hairline-thin — while looking correct on 1x screens. Inconsistent rendering across the owner's machines.
findings.fix: Multiply all font sizes, radii, paddings, tick lengths and lineWidths by scope.verticalPixelRatio/horizontalPixelRatio (pass the ratios through CoordConverter), mirroring SessionBandsPrimitive's approach.

findings.title: Pip-size heuristic '> 20 ? 0.01 : 0.0001' implemented twice with slightly different bases (close price vs max of two prices)
findings.impact: Pip math drift: if one site is fixed (e.g. to handle gold or a proper per-symbol pip table) the other keeps showing different pip figures for the same instrument, so the hover OC/HL pips and the measure-tool pips disagree.
findings.fix: Extract a single pipSizeFor(price or symbol) helper (ideally driven by the instrument's actual pip size from the backend) and use it in both places.

findings.title: Crosshair-move handler re-parses Date strings for up to 500 candles on every mousemove
findings.impact: Hundreds of thousands of Date parses per second of mouse movement on a 500-candle chart with several overlays — measurable jank on the main thread during normal chart use.
findings.fix: Precompute epoch-seconds once per candles update (e.g. a Map<number, CandleBar> alongside orderedRef) and look up by param.time directly; reuse it in onClick and the tooltip.

findings.title: Fib fan always extends toward the right pane edge, so a fan drawn right-to-left (p2 left of p1) renders mirrored through the anchor instead of through its defining points
findings.impact: A trader who anchors the fan at a recent swing and clicks back to an older swing (a natural gesture) gets fan rays on the wrong side with inverted slopes — levels look plausible but are geometrically meaningless.
findings.fix: Extend in the direction of p2: `const xEnd = x2 >= x1 ? conv.width : 0` and skip drawing when xRange === 0.

findings.title: Pitchfork lines are extended by a fixed 10x factor instead of to the pane edge — they stop mid-chart when the handle is short relative to the visible width
findings.impact: Median/fork support-resistance lines visibly terminate in the middle of the chart at wider zoom levels, so price interacting with the (unrendered) continuation looks like no level exists there.
findings.fix: Compute the extension analytically to the pane edge as ExtendedLinePrimitive does: slope = dy/dx, then draw to x = conv.width (or x = 0 for leftward forks), handling dx === 0 as a vertical line.

findings.title: Direct import from undeclared transitive dependency 'fancy-canvas' (not in ui/package.json)
findings.impact: A lightweight-charts upgrade that changes its fancy-canvas version (or a switch to pnpm/yarn-pnp strict hoisting) breaks the build or silently type-mismatches the renderer scope shapes.
findings.fix: Add fancy-canvas to ui/package.json dependencies pinned to lightweight-charts' expected range, and convert both CanvasRenderingTarget2D imports to `import type`.

findings.title: Drawing.label field is repurposed as the measure-label position enum ('top'|'middle'|'bottom'), colliding with its documented use as display text
findings.impact: Same field means two different things depending on tool — persistence, label editors, or export code treating `label` uniformly will misrender measure tools or lose the position setting.
findings.fix: Add a dedicated optional field to Drawing (e.g. `labelPosition?: 'top'|'middle'|'bottom'`) and stop overloading `label`.

findings.title: Band x-coordinate computation (visibility check, timeToCoordinate calls, fallback, clamping) duplicated verbatim between the fill loop and the label loop
findings.impact: Double the timeToCoordinate calls per band per frame, and any fix to the null-fallback bug must be applied in two places or the fill and label positions diverge.
findings.fix: Compute [x1, x2] once per band into an array in the first pass and reuse it for separators/labels.

findings.title: Session-band repaint forced via applyOptions({ visible: true }) side-channel hack on the candle series
findings.impact: Fragile: relies on lightweight-charts treating a no-op option write as a full invalidation (undocumented), and unconditionally forces the series visible. If lwc ever short-circuits unchanged options, band/drawing updates stop appearing until an unrelated repaint.
findings.fix: Capture SeriesAttachedParameter.requestUpdate in attached() (both SessionBandsPrimitive and BasePrimitive) and call it from updateBands()/updateData() — the documented primitive invalidation path.

findings.title: selectDoc has no out-of-order guard and discards unsaved editor content without a dirty check
findings.impact: Editor shows document B while the user clicked C; unsaved edits in the previous document are silently discarded on any tree click or search navigation.
findings.fix: Track a request sequence number (or AbortController) and apply only the latest response; compare editorRef.getValue() to initialContent before switching and confirm discard.

findings.title: getOrCreateImportFolder is TOCTOU — concurrent imports create duplicate '[Import]' folders
findings.impact: Two imports triggered close together (e.g. from two views) each see no folder and both create one — permanent duplicate '[Import]' folders that also collide in KbEditor's [[Title]] link map (title-keyed, last one wins). Note also ts() (line 7-17) uses browser-local time while backend timestamps are UTC, so import titles do not sort consistently with created_at.
findings.fix: Provide a server-side idempotent get-or-create endpoint (or unique index on (parent_id,title) for folders); serialize the client call behind a module-level promise as a stopgap.

findings.title: Heading anchor ids diverge from TableOfContents slugs: String(children) mangles inline markup and there is no duplicate-slug dedup
findings.impact: Clicking a TOC entry for any heading containing bold/italic/code/links, or for the 2nd+ occurrence of a repeated heading, scrolls nowhere or to the wrong heading.
findings.fix: Extract text recursively from the hast node (or flatten children strings) instead of String(children), and apply the same seen-count '-N' dedup used in parseHeadings so both sides produce identical slugs.

findings.title: TableOfContents is fed initialContent, never the live editor content — TOC is stale while editing and after save
findings.impact: TOC shows outdated headings; clicking entries for deleted headings does nothing, new sections are unlistable — looks like random breakage.
findings.fix: Lift the current content (debounced) up from KbEditor's onChange, or update initialContent after save from editorRef.getValue().

findings.title: parseHeadings matches '#' lines inside fenced code blocks — phantom TOC entries
findings.impact: TOC lists headings that do not exist in the preview; clicking them does nothing.
findings.fix: Track ``` fence state while iterating lines and skip lines inside fences.

findings.title: _ensure_kb_table runs DDL executescript + commit on every single KB request
findings.impact: Constant needless DDL churn per request, plus a subtle transaction-boundary hazard: a KB call can commit half of an unrelated in-flight write (e.g. order-book persistence) on the shared connection.
findings.fix: Create the tables once in initialize()/_run_migrations() and drop the per-call _ensure_kb_table invocations.

findings.title: FTS index not maintained when is_folder is toggled without a title/content change
findings.impact: Search results include folders (clicking navigates SearchPanel -> selectDoc -> editor shows nothing) or permanently miss documents converted from folders.
findings.fix: Also run the FTS delete/reinsert block when 'is_folder' is in updates.

findings.title: created_at/updated_at column defaults use datetime('now') format while all code paths insert ISO-8601 '+00:00' strings — dead defaults with a divergent format
findings.impact: Latent timestamp-format divergence in the same column; idx_kb_updated ordering would interleave incorrectly if the default ever fires.
findings.fix: Remove the defaults or change them to strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f+00:00','now') to match the Python format.

findings.title: renameVal initialized from doc.title only on mount — rename input pre-fills a stale title after external renames
findings.impact: A rename dialog opened after any other rename path reverts the document title to a stale value on a mere blur.
findings.fix: Set renameVal from the current doc.title when entering rename mode: onClick={() => { setRenameVal(doc.title); setRenaming(true); ... }}.

findings.title: BUILTIN_DOMAINS is stale — missing the 'news' domain, so the built-in-domain delete guard can be bypassed
findings.impact: `--deregister --tool-name get_news` followed by `--deletedomain news` deletes a built-in tool domain that the hardcoded guard was supposed to protect; any future built-in domain will silently miss the guard the same way.
findings.fix: Either derive the protected set from the folders that ship built-in registered tools, or at minimum add "news" and keep the list in sync with openforexai/tools/.

findings.title: Manager writes a redundant register_repository line for every new data adapter, propagating the deprecated API
findings.impact: Every scaffolded data adapter hard-codes the deprecated shim into the production __init__.py; removal of the shim later requires editing generated files too.
findings.fix: Emit only the register_data_container line (and delete REGISTER_REPO_RE plus the reg_repo_line handling at lines 19, 101, 108-109, 139).

findings.title: Demo tool publishes the real ROUTING_RELOAD_REQUESTED control event as its 'demo' bus message
findings.impact: Running the demo (or a tool copied from it) with emit_bus_message=true silently triggers a live routing-rules reload on a production system — e.g. picking up a half-edited event_routing.json5 mid-edit. A demo should use an inert event.
findings.fix: Publish a harmless/monitoring-only event type in the template, or clearly rename the parameter to reflect that it triggers a real routing reload.

findings.title: BaseTool docstring example uses the removed context.data_container API
findings.impact: The canonical example every tool developer reads teaches an API that raises AttributeError — same trap as demo_context_event_tool.py.
findings.fix: Update the docstring example to the bus_request()/repo_request() pattern.

findings.title: datetime.utcnow() — deprecated naive-UTC call in all four manager scripts
findings.impact: Only used for backup filename stamps, so impact is limited to DeprecationWarnings and convention drift — but templates are what users copy.
findings.fix: Replace with `datetime.now(UTC).strftime(...)` in all four files.

findings.title: Template test suite is never executed (testpaths excludes template/) and is currently red
findings.impact: All the high-severity template drift above accumulated precisely because these tests are dead weight — they document intent but verify nothing.
findings.fix: Either add template/ to testpaths (after fixing the templates) or delete the demo test files; also remove the orphaned template/__pycache__/__init__ pyc.

findings.title: _data_containers alias and get/list_data_containers are never used anywhere
findings.impact: Dead API surface that doubles the ways to reach one dict; the class-level alias would silently desync if anyone ever rebinds _repositories on a subclass.
findings.fix: Delete the `_data_containers` alias; after consolidating on one registration API (see compat finding), remove the unused getters/listers.

findings.title: get_historical_m5_candles violates its own contract: count=0 yields 1 candle and all candles share one identical timestamp
findings.impact: Demo-only, but a DataContainer persisting these would collapse them into one row (duplicate timestamps), so the template misleads about the oldest-first, unique-timestamp expectations of the gap-repair pipeline.
findings.fix: Generate timestamps as `now - (count-1-i) * timedelta(minutes=5)` and use `range(max(0, count))`.
